scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @stichbill/api && npm run build --workspace @stichbill/api-client && npm run build --workspace @stichbill/domain && npm run build --workspace @stichbill/worker && npm run build --workspace @stichbill/web
scripts.test:unit: npm run build --workspace @stichbill/api && node scripts/run-tests.mjs unit
scripts.test:integration: npm run build --workspace @stichbill/api && node --env-file-if-exists=.env scripts/run-tests.mjs integration
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test && npm run openapi:check
scripts.openapi:generate: npm run build --workspace @stichbill/api && node apps/api/dist/openapi.js && openapi-typescript packages/api-client/openapi.json -o packages/api-client/src/schema.d.ts
